Game Overview

At its heart, Sled Line is a christmas game about draw your path to keep the sleigh racing through a festive wonderland of ramps and obstacles. Precision and creativity are key as you guide the sleigh with your finger or mouse, balancing and avoiding pitfalls for an endless holiday adventure. Every line can lead you further!
